# Guideline Sources

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs/guideline-sources.ts from guideline-registry.yaml. Do not edit by hand; run `bun run docs:guideline-sources`. -->

Primary sources for the 49 reporting guidelines, appraisal tools, and templates that `methodsmith` reviews against. Every row comes from the [guideline registry](https://github.com/sajor2000/methodsmith/blob/main/plugins/methodsmith/skills/method-review/references/guideline-registry.yaml); registry verification date 2026-10-19.

Other PMIDs are errata, explanation papers, co-publications, and related records named in the registry notes. Superseded versions are never loaded; their old names resolve to the current entry.
